sections.heading: CGC Jhanjeri vs CGC Landran for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose CGC Jhanjeri if you want a recorded fee of ₹2.46 lakh, and an admission route through CMAT, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Mohali.
Choose CGC Landran if you want a recorded fee of ₹2.46 lakh, and an admission route through CAT, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Mohali.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for CGC Jhanjeri here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, CGC Jhanjeri or CGC Landran?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. CGC Jhanjeri and CGC Landran differ in more than one way: the useful differences are fees, the admission test and the kind of MBA / PGDM classroom each campus offers.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for CGC Jhanjeri vs CGC Landran?
faqs.answer: our records list ₹2.46 lakh for CGC Jhanjeri on MBA Digital Marketing; our records list ₹2.46 lakh for CGC Landran on MBA. Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for CGC Jhanjeri and CGC Landran?
faqs.answer: We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for CGC Jhanjeri here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do CGC Jhanjeri and CGC Landran accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list CMAT for CGC Jhanjeri, and CAT for CGC Landran. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are CGC Jhanjeri and CGC Landran in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Mohali, Punjab. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
